About SANTOSH PUBLIC JR.H. SCHOOL

SANTOSH PUBLIC JR.H. SCHOOL was established in 2004 and it is managed by the Pvt. Unaided. It is located in Urban area. It is located in LONI block of GHAZIABAD district of Uttar Pradesh. The school consists of Grades from 1 to 8. The school is Co-educational and it doesn't have an attached pre-primary section. The school is N/A in nature and is not using school building as a shift-school. Hindi is the medium of instructions in this school. This school is approachable by all weather road. In this school academic session starts in April.
         The school has Private building. It has got 19 classrooms for instructional purposes. All the classrooms are in good condition. It has 2 other rooms for non-teaching activities. The school has a separate room for Head master/Teacher. The school has Pucca boundary wall. The school has have electric connection. The source of Drinking Water in the school is Hand Pumps and it is functional. The school has 1 boys toilet and it is functional. and 1 girls toilet and it is functional. The school has a playground. The school has a library and has 250 books in its library. The school does not need ramp for disabled children to access classrooms. The school has 4 computers for teaching and learning purposes and all are functional. The school is having a computer aided learning lab. The school is Not Applicable providing mid-day meal.

Nurturing Bright Futures: Why Choosing the Right Primary School Matters

Published by Santosh Public School

Every child deserves a strong start in life, and that journey begins with quality education. A good primary school does much more than teach reading and writing—it helps children build confidence, develop good values, improve communication skills, and discover their unique talents. At Santosh Public School, we are committed to providing a safe, caring, and inspiring learning environment where every child can grow into a confident and responsible individual.

Building Strong Academic Foundations

The early years of education play a crucial role in a child's overall development. At Santosh Public School, we focus on building strong foundations in English, Mathematics, Science, and General Knowledge through engaging and activity-based learning methods.
Instead of relying only on textbooks, our teachers encourage students to participate in classroom discussions, educational games, storytelling, practical activities, and creative projects. This approach makes learning enjoyable while helping children understand concepts more effectively.

Experienced and Caring Teachers

Teachers have the greatest influence on a child's learning experience. Our qualified and dedicated teachers create a positive classroom atmosphere where every student feels valued, respected, and encouraged to ask questions.

We believe that every child learns differently, so our teachers provide individual attention whenever needed to help students improve academically and personally.

content:
Teaching Moral Values: Building Responsible and Compassionate Citizens at Santosh Public School

Published by Santosh Public School

In today's fast-changing world, education is not only about achieving good grades—it is also about shaping a child's character. Academic excellence is important, but values such as honesty, kindness, respect, responsibility, and compassion are equally essential for becoming a successful and respected member of society.

At Santosh Public School, we believe that moral education forms the foundation of a child's personality. Along with quality English Medium education, we focus on nurturing students who are disciplined, respectful, and socially responsible.

Why Moral Values Matter

Children learn by observing the people around them. The habits and values they develop during their early years often stay with them throughout their lives.
Moral education helps children:
  • Understand the difference between right and wrong.
  • Respect parents, teachers, elders, and classmates.
  • Develop honesty and integrity.
  • Show kindness and empathy toward others.
  • Become responsible members of society.
  • Build confidence and self-discipline.
When children grow with strong moral values, they are better prepared to face life's challenges with wisdom and confidence.

Learning Beyond Books

Education should prepare children for life, not just examinations. At Santosh Public School, learning extends beyond textbooks through activities that teach valuable life lessons.
Our students participate in:
  • Group activities that promote teamwork.
  • Classroom discussions on good behaviour.
  • Cultural celebrations that teach respect for diversity.
  • Storytelling sessions with moral messages.
  • Community awareness activities.
  • Cleanliness and environmental initiatives.
  • Sports that encourage discipline and sportsmanship.
These experiences help children understand that good character is just as important as academic success.

Respect for Everyone

One of the most important lessons children learn at Santosh Public School is to respect every individual regardless of age, background, or differences.
We encourage students to:
  • Speak politely.
  • Listen carefully to others.
  • Help classmates in need.
  • Appreciate different opinions.
  • Treat everyone with kindness and fairness.
Respect creates a positive school environment where every child feels safe, valued, and confident.
